changelog:
ecommerce-listing-skill 1.0.0 — Initial release

- Extracts structured, paginated product lists (URL, name, price, currency, image, rating, review count) from any public e-commerce category or search results page.
- Supports input via direct URL, keyword search, or site-scoped search with filters (price range, brand, category, min rating, in-stock, sort order).
- Works with Amazon, eBay, Walmart, Google Shopping, Shopify collections, WooCommerce, and most public product listing pages.
- Automated pagination handles next-page URLs and load-more buttons.
- All progress updates and messages follow the user's language settings.
- Includes error handling, memory of past issues, and uptime/resumption strategies.
summary: Extract product list from any e-commerce category page, search results page, or keyword search with filters. Returns paginated product arrays with URL, name,...
